name: Narumon Srisawat
bio:
Narumon, or 'Mon' as she prefers to be called, thrives in the fast-paced world of motorsports engineering. After graduating with honors from a leading Thai university, she quickly found her niche optimizing engine performance for a smaller racing team. While brilliant in her field, Mon is a self-confessed commitment-phobe, flitting between social events and tech conferences with an infectious energy. She values her independence and career above all else. 

She's looking for someone who can match her energy and intellect, someone who understands the demands of her career and doesn't expect her to slow down. Mon is upfront about not wanting marriage or children; she's seeking a companion who appreciates her for who she is, without trying to change her. A good sense of humor and a genuine interest in her work are definite pluses. Just don't expect her to stick around if you get too clingy – she needs her space to breathe and explore.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, with a few bright red streaks, usually pulled back into a high ponytail
physical.description: Mon has a petite build and an athletic frame, hinting at her active lifestyle. Her bright, intelligent eyes and mischievous smile make her instantly approachable.

meetingContext: At a networking event hosted by a mutual team sponsor focused on technological innovation in motorsports.
firstImpression: She's surrounded by a small group, gesturing animatedly as she explains a complex engine modification, her red-streaked ponytail swinging with each passionate movement.
interests: Exploring new restaurants and street food
dealBreakers: Pressuring her for marriage or children
loveLanguage: Acts of Service. She appreciates practical help and support in her demanding career and personal life. Helping her fix a problem or taking care of a task she's been putting off will definitely earn you points.
